name: Sage Intacct
description: Sage Intacct is Sage's cloud financial management platform for mid-market companies and nonprofits, covering core financials (accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash management, general ledger, order management, and purchasing), automated multi-entity consolidation, a multi-dimensional general ledger, and AI-assisted close tools. Sage positions it for organizations that have outgrown small-business accounting software and need to consolidate multiple entities or track funds and grants.
best_for: Growing mid-market companies and nonprofits that have outgrown small-business accounting software and need multi-entity consolidation, dimensional reporting, or dedicated fund/grant accounting.
features: Core financials: accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash management, general ledger, order management, and purchasing
Automated multi-entity consolidation across currencies and geographies
Multi-dimensional general ledger for reporting without a bloated chart of accounts
Real-time, customizable dashboards tracking key metrics and goal progress
AI-assisted month-end close that tracks tasks and flags issues before they block the close
AI-based outlier detection for reviewing general-ledger transactions
Dedicated nonprofit capabilities: fund and grant tracking
pros: Purpose-built multi-entity consolidation that Sage says can handle hundreds of entities across currencies and geographies
Multi-dimensional general ledger aimed specifically at mid-market finance teams' reporting needs
Dedicated nonprofit fund- and grant-accounting features, not general-purpose accounting adapted after the fact
cons: No published self-serve pricing in the US — Sage routes buyers through a scoping call to a written quote
A bigger step up in cost and implementation effort than small-business accounting tools like QuickBooks or Wave

tiers.name: Sage Intacct
tiers.notes: Custom-quote pricing based on which modules/products are included. Sage does not publish self-serve numeric pricing for the US market; buyers go through a scoping call and receive a written quote.

alternatives.name: NetSuite
alternatives.description: Oracle's cloud ERP system unifying accounting, inventory, order management, and multi-subsidiary consolidation.
alternatives.best_for: Companies that need inventory, order management, and broader operational ERP alongside financial consolidation, not just financials.

alternatives.name: Odoo
alternatives.description: An open-source, modular business platform covering accounting, inventory, manufacturing, and more as individually priced apps.
alternatives.best_for: Smaller organizations that want published, per-user pricing and a lighter-weight app instead of a custom-quoted platform.

alternatives.name: QuickBooks Online
alternatives.description: Small-business accounting software for invoicing, expense tracking, and basic financial reporting.
alternatives.best_for: Smaller organizations or single entities that don't yet need multi-entity consolidation or dimensional reporting.
